title: Why Teen Friendships Fade After One Term
summary: Help a teenager understand friendship drift and choose one small follow-up without taking over the relationship.
release_move: Support one small follow-up, then let the teenager decide whom they want to keep investing in and how they want to respond.

core_belief_shift.from: A fading friendship always proves rejection or a hidden social failure.
core_belief_shift.to: Shared structure can disappear, and one chosen follow-up helps a teen learn what connection needs next.

book_relevance.reason: The parent first needs to understand friendship drift without taking over; a product CTA would distract from that work.
